preConditions.sqlCheck: select count(*) from stretchy_report where report_name = 'Tranche release repayments'

column.name: description
column.value: Repayments that count toward the next tranche once the configured percentage of the previous tranche has been paid.

insert.column: SELECT ml.account_no AS loanAccount, mc.display_name AS clientName, ms.display_name AS loanOfficer, prev.principal AS previousTranchePrincipal, lp.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage AS requiredPercent, ROUND(prev.principal * lp.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage / 100, 2) AS requiredPrincipal, repaid.principal_repaid AS principalRepaid, lt.id AS repaymentId, lt.transaction_date AS repaymentDate, lt.amount AS repaymentAmount, lt.principal_portion_derived AS principalPortion FROM m_loan ml JOIN m_product_loan lp ON lp.id = ml.product_id LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = ml.client_id LEFT JOIN m_staff ms ON ms.id = ml.loan_officer_id JOIN m_loan_disbursement_detail prev ON prev.loan_id = ml.id AND prev.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL JOIN m_loan_disbursement_detail nxt ON nxt.loan_id = ml.id AND nxt.disbursedon_date IS NULL JOIN m_loan_transaction lt ON lt.loan_id = ml.id AND lt.transaction_type_enum = 2 AND lt.is_reversed = 0 AND lt.transaction_date >= prev.disbursedon_date JOIN ( SELECT t.loan_id, p.disbursedon_date, COALESCE(SUM(t.principal_portion_derived), 0) AS principal_repaid FROM m_loan_transaction t JOIN m_loan_disbursement_detail p ON p.loan_id = t.loan_id AND p.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL WHERE t.transaction_type_enum = 2 AND t.is_reversed = 0 AND t.transaction_date >= p.disbursedon_date AND p.id = ( SELECT p2.id FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail p2 WHERE p2.loan_id = t.loan_id AND p2.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p2.disbursedon_date DESC, p2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY t.loan_id, p.disbursedon_date ) repaid ON repaid.loan_id = ml.id AND repaid.disbursedon_date = prev.disbursedon_date WHERE lp.allow_multiple_disbursals = 1 AND lp.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage IS NOT NULL AND prev.id = ( SELECT p3.id FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail p3 WHERE p3.loan_id = ml.id AND p3.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p3.disbursedon_date DESC, p3.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND repaid.principal_repaid >= ROUND(prev.principal * lp.previous_tranche_repaid_percentage / 100, 2) ORDER BY ml.account_no, lt.transaction_date, lt.id
